component.summary: Local offline speech-to-text transcription using Whisper

Τοπική μεταγραφή ομιλίας σε κείμενο, χωρίς σύνδεση, με Whisper

description.p: Speech to Text turns your voice and audio recordings into text on your computer. Made for Fedora with the GNOME desktop, tested on Fedora 44. Whisper, Parakeet and Qwen3-ASR process audio locally after downloading a model.
Optional AI tools send transcript text to a service you choose. The startup update check contacts GitHub and can be disabled in Settings.

ul.li: Dictate with a global shortcut and a small floating panel
Transcribe audio files and translate to English with Whisper
Use Vulkan GPU acceleration with CPU fallback
Search transcription history and export text
Choose your interface language and a light, dark or system theme

description.p: Private, everyday dictation made for Fedora and the GNOME desktop.

ul.li: Local transcription with Whisper, Parakeet and Qwen3-ASR
Global dictation shortcuts, progressive text and safe cancellation
Retry failed audio without recording again
Searchable history, text export and optional AI tools
Full version display and clickable GitHub update notices
Fedora RPM with Vulkan acceleration and CPU fallback
